messages:
emily: Quick heads-up 19:30 UTC release window for a small IAM trust tweak across accounts (module=infra/iam-cross-account, workspace=prod). Need provider pin + rollback gating.

rick: ack. which aws provider version are we pinning to and why?

emily: pin to registry.terraform.io/hashicorp/aws v4.55.3 11 reason: last known-good after a policy encoding change in 4.56. Planning staging canary at 18:30 UTC (30m before prod).

deploybot: Pin applied: aws -> 4.55.3 for branch release/2026-06. Auto-updates paused until 2026-06-03T00:00:00Z. Schedule: staging 2026-06-02T18:30:00Z, prod 2026-06-02T19:30:00Z.

harry: preflight plan (staging):
```
# module.infra/iam-cross-account
~ aws_iam_role.cross_account (policy update)
+ aws_iam_policy_attachment.cross_attach
```
Looks like 1 update + 1 add.

zara: Rollback approach: Plan A = targeted re-apply from git tag `release/2026-05-28` using:
```
git checkout tags/release/2026-05-28 && terraform apply -target=module.iam-cross-account -auto-approve
```
This reverts policy text only. Plan B = toggle role alias (if available) to previous ARN to restore assume behavior instantly. Avoid `state rm` unless state is corrupted.

chris: also important: capture a state snapshot before prod apply: `terraform state pull > state.before.prod.json` and upload to safe storage. Don't run any `import` during the window unless part of the rollback doc.

emily: deploybot, please set abort thresholds and emergency fallback provider. Abort if >5% auth failures within any 3m window on canary. If abort triggers, fallback provider aws@4.54.0 and run targeted rollback command. Notify @oncall-eng immediately.

deploybot: Threshold configured: abort_on_metric(auth_failure_rate, 3m) > 0.05. On abort: pin aws->4.54.0, run rollback apply on commit tag, and post alert to #eng-oncall + page @oncall-eng.

rick: I'll draft the release notes: short blurb about cross-account trust policy update, post-deploy checks (1) k8s nodes can assume role (2) CI jobs using the role can acquire creds (3) monitoring shows no auth spikes. Adding runbook link: https://wiki.redwood.ai/runbooks/iam-deploy-checks

emily: primary for the window = @emily, backup = @rick. Pager group = @oncall-eng. I'll post an ops status msg 20m before staging canary.

zara: during staging run please use `terraform plan -out=canary.plan -target=module.iam-cross-account --refresh=false` to speed things up and reduce drift noise.

chris: SRE will standby for the prod apply at 19:30 UTC and will coordinate immediate mitigation if we hit the abort threshold.

emily: thanks all. I'll attach the small diff to the release notes and push the branch. Communication plan: status in #eng-infra and short incident update in #incidents if anything tripped. End.
